_comment: The easier Claude Desktop route is to download the .mcpb from Settings > Agent apps > Connect an agent app and double-click it.
For manual setup, merge the entries you want into your claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers map.
Replace <REPO> with the absolute path to your clone. The bridge needs Node.js >=18; if node is not on the app PATH, use its absolute path.
MAESTRO_CS_BACKEND_URL is the local backend address (compose publishes port 8001 by default). Never publish that port or proxy /mcp beyond this computer.
Enable ONE Maestro profile per chat: full includes every scoped tool set.
The bridge forwards the assistant clientInfo, so Career KB timeline rows keep the client name.

For the optional Playwright server, replace <NODE> and <HOME> with the absolute Node path and your home directory. Browser output paths and Maestro upload staging must agree; see the MCP server guide.
Quit Claude Desktop fully before editing its config file, then restart it.
